name: legislation
description: legislation.gov.uk is the official UK legislation database (Acts, Statutory Instruments, devolved legislation). This CLI searches legislation and fetches items as structured data through the site's documented open-data URLs (Atom feeds and XML).

commands.name: search-legislation
commands.summary: Search UK legislation by keyword, title, type or year. Returns an Atom feed of matching items.

params.name: title
params.description: Restrict to items whose title contains these words

params.name: year
params.description: Year of enactment, e.g. 2018, or a range like 2010-2018

commands.name: get-legislation
commands.summary: Get one legislation item, such as the Data Protection Act 2018 (ukpga/2018/12), as structured XML-derived JSON with metadata and text.

params.name: number
params.description: Chapter or SI number within the year, e.g. 12

notes: UNVERIFIED: during exploration, every request to www.legislation.gov.uk returned an AWS WAF bot-challenge page (HTTP 202, empty #challenge-container). No real site content was observed.

These commands use legislation.gov.uk's documented open-data URL patterns (/search/data.feed and /{type}/{year}/{number}/data.xml), not recorded responses. resultPath and defaultFields come from the documented Atom and CLML formats and may need adjusting once a real response is seen.

The AWS WAF token endpoints (E1 /inputs and E2 /mp_verify) are deliberately excluded. They are bot-protection machinery, not site capabilities, and this CLI does not try to solve or get around the challenge.

If the WAF keeps blocking non-browser clients, these commands will get the challenge page instead of data. The legitimate fix is to ask The National Archives (the site operator) for API access or allow-listing, or to use their bulk data downloads. Do not try to forge challenge tokens.

Content is published under the Open Government Licence. The same documents are also available as data.json/data.html/data.pdf variants, and sections can be fetched as /{type}/{year}/{number}/section/{n}/data.xml.
